items.exampleEn: Money is not my only motivation for working.

items.exampleEn: Please don't use offensive words in class.

那位消防員表現出極大的勇氣。

items.sentenceEn: Being curious helps children learn faster.
items.sentenceZh: 好奇心幫助孩子學得更快。

items.audioEn: Her score on the test was impressive: ninety out of a hundred.
items.audioZh: 她的考試成績令人印象深刻：一百分拿了九十分。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't swear in front of the children.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要在孩子面前罵髒話。

items.sentenceEn: The long wait at the bank caused a lot of frustration.
items.sentenceZh: 在銀行等很久，讓大家很沮喪。

items.stemEn: Telling the truth sometimes takes a lot of ____.
items.stemZh: 說實話有時候需要很大的勇氣。

items.stemEn: Your English is very ____; how long have you studied?
items.stemZh: 你的英文好得令人印象深刻，你學多久了？

items.passageEn: Mina is a gifted art student, but last year she almost gave up. She felt deep frustration because her paintings never won any prizes. Her teacher gave her some realistic advice: "Don't lose your motivation. Stay curious and try new styles." Mina found the courage to show her work online. A few comments were offensive, but many people found her paintings impressive. Now she swears she will never give up again.
items.passageZh: Mina 是學美術的學生，很有天分，但去年她差點放棄。她非常沮喪，因為她的畫從來沒得過獎。老師給了她一些實際的建議：「別失去動力。保持好奇，試試新的風格。」Mina 鼓起勇氣把作品放上網路。有幾則留言很冒犯人，但很多人覺得她的畫令人印象深刻。現在她發誓再也不放棄了。

questions.questionZh: Mina 去年為什麼差點放棄？

items.promptZh: 他很好奇這個盒子裡有什麼。
referenceEn: He is curious about what is in this box.
He is very curious about what is inside the box.
rubricZh: be curious about＋名詞或 what 子句（例如 curious about what is in the box）
子句用直述語序（what is in…）
寫 He wonders what is in the box. 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 courage 造一個句子，說說一件你覺得需要勇氣的事。
referenceEn: It took courage for me to speak in front of my class.
I need courage to try new things.
rubricZh: courage 是不可數名詞「勇氣」
可用 It takes courage to…、have the courage to… 等說法（例如 It took courage for me to…）
時態配合內容（例如 took、need）
